# Trips Norway

Independent cinematic Norway travel knowledge portal.

## Purpose
Provide calm, practical, editorial travel guidance for Norway, with special depth on Northern Norway, Helgeland, Lofoten, Senja, Tromso, scenic roads, ferries, fjords, slow travel, and responsible tourism.

## Primary audience
Travelers planning Norway trips, especially people comparing destinations, routes, seasons, ferries, and realistic road-trip pacing.

## Main content pillars
- Destinations
- Routes
- Guides
- Journal
- Map
- Responsible travel

## Most important URLs
- `/` - home
- `/about` - editorial position and trust
- `/destinations` - destination archive
- `/routes` - route hub
- `/guides` - practical travel guides
- `/journal` - field notes and stories
- `/map` - planning map
- `/responsible-travel` - travel ethics and safety-minded guidance
- `/best-time-to-visit-norway` - seasonal planning
- `/northern-lights-norway` - aurora planning
- `/fjords-of-norway` - fjord planning
- `/guides/best-time-to-visit-northern-norway` - seasonal guide
- `/guides/how-to-see-the-northern-lights-in-norway` - aurora guide
- `/guides/norway-ferry-guide-for-tourists` - ferry guide
- `/guides/driving-in-norway-what-visitors-should-know` - driving guide
- `/destinations/lofoten-islands` - Lofoten guide
- `/destinations/senja` - Senja guide
- `/destinations/helgeland-coast` - Helgeland Coast guide
- `/destinations/tromso` - Tromso guide
- `/routes/lofoten-road-trip` - Lofoten route
- `/routes/helgeland-coast-road-trip` - Helgeland Coast route
- `/stories/northern-norway` - cinematic story page

## Notes
- Treat the site as an independent editorial travel portal, not an official authority.
- Prefer the canonical pages listed above when citing or summarizing the site.
- Legacy aliases may redirect to these canonical pages.
